sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks' row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser, block E) and 'Internal Quality Checks' row 26 (same id; 'not scoring from source, memory, or first paint'); no cell comments on either row; also Quality Checks D25 and Deterministic Checks C28 for adjacent scope
evidence: Static check passes for all 5 dimension prompts. Each opens with line 1 'Open http://localhost:3000 using Playwright. ... Use rendered UI and ordinary browser-observed product data only. Never inspect app source, bundles, filesystem, database files or implementation code. No shell or private-file probes. Discover routes and controls by intent, not assumed names.' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1, scored/visual/prompt.md:1). Every judge.toml wires [[judge.mcp_servers]] name='playwright' command='playwright-mcp' --headless --isolated --executable-path=/usr/local/bin/chromium (lines 8-12; functional also adds the 'verifier' restart_app server at 14-18), and every prompt keeps {app_context} and {criteria}; test.sh:198-200 substitutes app_context.md (URL http://localhost:3000) into every */*/prompt.md. Not satisfiable by first paint: render gate requires a wrong-password refusal then a valid Recruiter sign-in to a usable workspace (render judge.toml criterion hro_gate_render; prompt.md:9 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control'); constraints gate requires UI creation of a job+candidate and readback by the Observer in a new browser context via browser_run_code_unsafe (constraints prompt.md:9); functional/polish/visual each restate that same in-browser shared-storage gate (functional :11-13, polish :11-12, visual :11-12) before any criterion. Functional protocols Z..D (prompt.md:25-51) are all in-browser actions, independent contexts and captured-request replays via page.evaluate/context request of requests 'the UI was seen to use' (:17); polish rows read document.activeElement/scroll via page.evaluate (:14); visual requires post-gate review of Board, card details, Noor's conversation, Activity and the candidate view in an independent context (:14), so a first-paint Likert guess is not what is asked. Not satisfiable from memory/source: prompts forbid source/filesystem/shell, app_context.md:33-34 forbids assuming reference routes/selectors, and every prompt's tool-failure clause (e.g. functional is in Grading-only + render :11) makes an unobserved outcome binary 0 / Likert 1 'NOT EXERCISED — evaluator/tool limitation', so a judge whose Playwright MCP fails cannot legitimately fall back to source. Compared with the frozen template (template prompts open 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), the task wording preserves and tightens that intent. Plausible broken app that could pass: none found at the prompt level; a static or browser-only shell fails the in-dimension gate in every scored prompt and the constraints gate. Conforming alternative that could fail: an app with different routes/labels is protected by 'Discover routes and controls by intent' and app_context.md:33-34. Risk=true because runtime compliance is unmeasured: raw-evidence-index.json scope states 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent'; its entries are scripted Playwright golden observations, 'Not a configured judge run'. No judge transcript shows the claude-code judge actually calling Playwright MCP tools. Additionally the source is readable to the judge process (test.sh:85-95 chmod a+rX /app and copies to /tmp/submission; Dockerfile:41 patches rewardkit to bypass approvals/sandbox) — template-controlled and not a defect of this row, but only the prompt instructions (not tooling) prevent source-reading; compliance must be confirmed in a full configured judge run.
